source_integrity.summary: Revision 2 pending and both staged locale source SHA verified and pinned immediately before QA decision.

schema_and_taxonomy.summary: v2 ready daily-global-macro metadata; English canonical, PT-BR counterpart, registered political-economy-markets program and controlled strategic-competition phenomenon.

source_vintage_and_cutoff.summary: 05:00 BRT 13 Nov cutoff; 12 Nov US completed close and Treasury observations, 10 Nov earlier official yields, 11 Nov bond holiday; US October PPI and Eurostat revision unobserved at cutoff.

factual_methodology.summary: Primary U.S. Treasury Nov10/12 2Y4.73/4.86 and 10Y4.98/5.10; China NBS October PPI5.7 CPI0.7 y/y and producer subcomponents; BLS Sep PPI1.3 monthly verified; other data traced to AP, BLS CPI, Eurostat, BCB, IBGE index and dated local reporting; distinctions stock/flow and y/y vs m/m explicit.

evidence_traceability.summary: 13 identical reference URLs including official Treasury, Chinese NBS, BLS, FOMC, Copom and Eurostat. Brazilian Oct IPCA exact numeric release supported by dated financial press with IBGE reference index, not matched to directly retrievable IBGE dated release. No unsupported global credit spread or funds-flow magnitudes inferred.

research_depth.summary: EN 2739 and PT-BR 2933 substantive words; developed sovereign yield transmission through lending and data center capex, China factory/consumer price wedge, Brazil fiscal/monetary channels, European heterogeneity and explicit opposing scenarios.

visual_evidence_readiness.summary: Two quantitative chart series with identical EN/PT numeric arrays (Treasury nominal yields and China CPI/PPI), dated evidence table, two-chain causal diagram, spatial comparison map and counterfactual table. Units and observation windows explicit.

bilingual_equivalence.summary: 13 references identical and ordered, 2 chart datasets identical, 11 H2 sections, aligned factual observation periods, qualitative qualifications, regional mechanisms and alternative interpretations.

editorial_publication_readiness.summary: Natural institutional prose without publication workflow, first-person drafting notes or generic metadescriptions; descriptions connect actors, mechanisms, prices and financing outcomes.

contrary_evidence.summary: No one-for-one Treasury-to-credit spread assumption; no AI demand collapse inferred from stock decline; China CPI does not follow industry PPI mechanically; Brazil monthly IPCA alone does not imply rate cut.

counterfactual_review.summary: Rates-led tightening versus valuation-only correction; energy-driven inflation versus freight stabilization; upstream versus household China price transmission; quantified observational tests included.

pipeline_validation.summary: QA manually checked same substantive thresholds as validate-editorial-depth.mjs and verified pinned source SHA and report grammar; full npm validation and production deployment remain separate publisher/build responsibilities.

contrary_evidence: Higher Treasury yields do not prove higher company-specific credit spreads or cancelled infrastructure investment.
Chinese industrial PPI +5.7% y/y and household CPI +0.7% y/y measure different baskets, not directly identical inflation processes.
October Brazil IPCA +0.14% m/m is not evidence by itself of annual target convergence.
Eurostat quarterly GDP differences among European countries complicate a single eurozone growth narrative.
limitations: No independently verified aggregate global corporate credit-spread or fund-flow panel.
US October PPI and revised 13 Nov Eurostat GDP not yet observed by the 05:00 BRT cutoff.
Brazil October IPCA official statistical-series calendar and dated press corroboration; no direct official release article verified.
Independent assistant QA was performed using explicit source, numerical and SHA checks, not a separate human peer review.
End-to-end npm production build and production HTTP visibility have not yet been validated.
notes: Revision 2 verified against dated primary economic data, with explicit evidence limitations. SHA-bound approval; publisher must recheck exact object hashes prior to creating public files.
